Actions.description:
What happens to a claim that does not stand, by the task's context (an output kind or a document kind);
`default` for any other. A context the contract lists as immutable is never rewritten.

replace_with.description: The caveat a blocked passage gives way to, in a mutable output.
replace_with.title: Replace With

Actions.title: Actions

AgentStateMeta.description: One working state of a customer, as the Console shows it: never its content.

bytes.description: The size of the state's body.
bytes.title: Bytes

AgentStateMeta.title: AgentStateMeta

AgentStateScope.description:
What one working state belongs to. The id travels in the body, never in a URL: a conversation id may
look like a phone number.
AgentStateScope.title: AgentStateScope

AgentStateWrite.description:
A write of an agent's working state, by its code and never by a model: `cas` replaces the whole state
at `if_version` (0 when it must not exist yet); `merge_by_key` replaces each top-level field it names and
removes a field written as exactly `{"$delete": true}`.

subject.description: The customer the state is about, when its scope does not name them: erasing the customer and their data package find the state by it.

AgentStateWrite.title: AgentStateWrite

coverage.description: Counted apart: law and fact never add up.
coverage.title: Coverage

ArmComparison.description:
One arm against `control` on one metric, adjusted by CUPED when the history varies, with the mixture
sequential test: its p-value and interval hold at any look, so the report may be read every day.

ci_low.description: The always-valid interval of `difference` at the test's `alpha`.
ci_low.title: Ci Low

decided.description: `p_value` at or below `alpha`: the difference is real.
decided.title: Decided

difference.description: The arm minus the control, per person, adjusted.
difference.title: Difference

looks.description: The daily looks kept before this one.
looks.title: Looks

p_value.description: The running minimum over the daily looks and this one.
p_value.title: P Value

variance_reduction.description: The share of the variance CUPED removed; absent when it did not apply.
variance_reduction.title: Variance Reduction

ArmComparison.title: ArmComparison

ArmOutcomes.description: The people one arm holds and what they did after they were assigned, from the outcome links.

converted.description: People with an outcome in a success state.
converted.title: Converted

value_minor.description: Their lines' money, each line once whatever the method.
value_minor.title: Value Minor

ArmOutcomes.title: ArmOutcomes

AssertionStats.description:
One assertion over the run's completed executions, against its baseline. `p_value` is the one-sided
Fisher exact test that the run passes less often than the baseline, rounded to 6 decimals.

drop.description: The baseline's pass rate minus the run's.
drop.title: Drop

AssertionStats.title: AssertionStats

Attribute.description:
What the person is: a size, a preferred network, a diet. Said here; the lifecycle's outcomes (bought,
kept, returned for size) derive the rest on the server, never an agent.
Attribute.title: Attribute

AttributionReport.description:
Value by day, agent, method and band, deterministic and probable apart; a value is never multiplied by
a confidence, and no total adds a probable value to a deterministic one.
AttributionReport.title: AttributionReport

AttributionTotal.description: One method, band and finality over the period: deterministic and probable are never added together.
AttributionTotal.title: AttributionTotal

BiFile.description:
The company's BI export for the period, uploaded first (`POST /v1/measure/reconcile/uploads`), as CSV
with a header: `order` (the id the company knows the object by), `line` (optional), `value` (in major
units, as the signed definition nets it) and `currency`. It is read once and deleted.
BiFile.title: BiFile

upload_headers.description: Send exactly these headers; the storage refuses other bytes.
upload_headers.title: Upload Headers

BiUploadRequest.description: Reserves the upload of the company's BI file: its size and SHA-256, which the storage checks.
BiUploadRequest.title: BiUploadRequest

BoundArg.description:
One argument of the tool and the field it carries. `in` and `eq` render to `param`, `not_in` and `ne`
to the negation's, and a comparison or `between` only when `ops` lists it.

transform.description: The case text is sent in.
transform.title: Transform

BoundArg.title: BoundArg

Change.description:
One entry of the change log a bisection walks: a pin that changed between two builds of an agent, or
a section of the space's configuration that changed between two applied snapshots (`config`, named by
the section, with no agent: every agent reads it, and its digests stand for the values).

name.description: The prompt or the tool, for those kinds.
name.title: Name

Change.title: Change

ChangeSinceSeen.description: A field of an interest whose value is not the one the subject was shown.

observed_at.description: When the source observed the value now held.
observed_at.title: Observed At

ChangeSinceSeen.title: ChangeSinceSeen

CheckRequest.description:
What an agent is about to do. Without a subject there is no budget, suppression or owner to consult:
such a check only asks about the effect key.

destination_hash.description: The token's `rcpt`, computed by a caller that holds the gateway's key, when the destination is not the subject's handle.
destination_hash.title: Destination Hash

effect_key.description: The business fact's key; reserved atomically when nothing holds it.
effect_key.title: Effect Key

CheckRequest.title: CheckRequest

CheckResult.description:
The coordination decision. `reasons` are codes (the coordination spec, 4); `holder` is who to hand
off to with `handoff_to`. `contact_token` comes only with an allowed outbound contact of a purpose that
needs one.
CheckResult.title: CheckResult

ClaimContractSummary.description:
The contract as the SDK keeps it: everything but the negative corpus's phrases, which only the CI's
`niadra contract test` reads, from the company's own copy.
ClaimContractSummary.title: ClaimContractSummary

ClaimEvidence.description: What the turn record must hold for a claim of the category to stand: exactly one kind.

tool.description: A call of this tool in the turn.
tool.title: Tool

ClaimEvidence.title: ClaimEvidence

ClaimEvidenceRef.description: Where a claim's evidence is in the turn record: a call's field, an object's field, or a document.

anchor.description: The blob that keeps the quoted text.
anchor.title: Anchor

ClaimEvidenceRef.title: ClaimEvidenceRef

ClaimRecord.description: One claim the SDK found in an output, as the turn record carries it: kinds, spans and verdicts.

action.description: What was done, which the contract's configured action decides: `rewrite_if_unequivocal` is `rewrite` when the rewrite is unequivocal and `warn` otherwise, `discard_anchor_and_count` is `discard_anchor`, and a claim that stands (`matched`, `quoted_found`, `anchored`) is `none`.
action.title: Action

span.description: Code point offsets of the claim in the output, end exclusive.
span.title: Span

ClaimRecord.title: ClaimRecord

ClaimRequest.description:
A declared claim, held by `holder`. `level` defaults to the space's least restrictive level; a
declaration is refused (409 `lease_held`) while another holder's claim is at least as restrictive, and the
same holder renews its own. `lease_s` is capped by the space's longest declared lease. A task lock names
an object and its `task`, and is refused (409 `task_locked`) while another holder has that task.

observed_at.description: When the source saw it; an observation older than the source's last is ignored.
observed_at.title: Observed At

source.description: An observation of this ownership source, read and sent by the company's worker: never refused, replacing what the source said before, and capped by the source's validity.
source.title: Source

ClaimRequest.title: ClaimRequest

ClaimValue.description:
A number the parser read, normalized: an amount, or a range from `min` to `max`, with its unit (the
currency code of money, `%`, a time unit, a unit of measure or of dose), or a date, or a range of
dates.
ClaimValue.title: ClaimValue

ClaimVia.description:
The three ways in: a declaration through the API, an observation mapped from a webhook, an observation
the company's worker read and sent.
ClaimVia.title: ClaimVia

CommitmentDecidedDetail.description: The person accepted or declined a commitment, maybe in a later conversation.
CommitmentDecidedDetail.title: CommitmentDecidedDetail

CommitmentMadeDetail.description: `score` ranks commitments of a `best_wins` type: the higher holds.
CommitmentMadeDetail.title: CommitmentMadeDetail

CompanyRule.description:
A rule of the company delivered in the block, with where it lives and its rank in the order the company
declared: the block never ranks two origins by itself.
CompanyRule.title: CompanyRule

Conflict.description:
Two entries that cannot both hold, and the one that won: the current utterance over what was stated
before, and a stated entry over an inferred one. Between two company rules, it is also a data issue.
Conflict.title: Conflict

ConflictCounts.description: What coordination settled between parties in the window.

commitments_superseded.description: Commitments another of the subject's held first.
commitments_superseded.title: Commitments Superseded

handoffs_expired.description: Handoffs whose outcome did not come back in time.
handoffs_expired.title: Handoffs Expired

ownership_overlaps.description: Subjects and objects two holders claimed at the same time: the more restrictive held.
ownership_overlaps.title: Ownership Overlaps

tokens_reused.description: Contact tokens declared used more than once.
tokens_reused.title: Tokens Reused

ConflictCounts.title: ConflictCounts

ConstraintsBlock.description: What one subject wants, refuses and is, for the tools of this turn (`constraints.v0`).

ask.description: Questions the agent should ask, as `for_whom`, before assuming.
ask.title: Ask

instructions.description: What people said must or must not be done about the objects the read is about.
instructions.title: Instructions

relaxation_order.description: What gives way first when a search finds nothing: `soft`, ids.
relaxation_order.title: Relaxation Order

text.description: The block as lines for a model, in the space's language, each field by its label and each operator in words; an empty string when the block has nothing to say. Not part of `version`.
text.title: Text

version.description: A digest of the block, which the turn record cites.
version.title: Version

ConstraintsBlock.title: ConstraintsBlock

at_limit.description: Of them, the ones with no contact left in the window.
at_limit.title: At Limit

subjects.description: Subjects with a contact still in the budget's window.
subjects.title: Subjects

ContactKey.description: An Ed25519 public key as a JWK (RFC 8037). A `retiring` key still verifies and signs nothing new.
ContactKey.title: ContactKey

ContactKeys.description: A space's public keys a gateway checks a contact token with, offline.
ContactKeys.title: ContactKeys

ContactMadeDetail.description:
`jti` is the contact token's; `unchecked` says the contact left without a decision, because the
purpose fails open and none came in time.
ContactMadeDetail.title: ContactMadeDetail

ContentMarker.description: A content field whose text Niadra does not hold (`pointer`, `hash_only`), or holds under scan.

pointer.description: Where the SDK reads the text inside the company's boundary.
pointer.title: Pointer

ContentMarker.title: ContentMarker

CoordinationOverview.description:
What coordination holds now and decided in the window, in counts: no subject, handle or message is in
it.

awaiting_decision.description: Effects whose outcome nobody knows, at any age: never sent again by themselves, they wait for a system event or a person.
awaiting_decision.title: Awaiting Decision

CoordinationOverview.title: CoordinationOverview

CoordinationReport.description:
A shadow run: the space's policy applied to its outbound messages already ingested, with nothing
enforced. `summary` holds the conflicts found and per 1,000 customers a month, without anyone in them.
CoordinationReport.title: CoordinationReport

CounterfactualCase.description:
One recorded tool call run live three times at the same moment: twice with the element (the base,
whose two lists measure the tool's own noise) and once without it (the variant). Positions and
overlaps only: never an item, an argument or a result.

base_count.description: Items in the base's first list.
base_count.title: Base Count

dry_run.description: The calls ran as the tool's dry run.
dry_run.title: Dry Run

k.description: The positions compared: the recorded list's `visible_k`, else the run's `k`.
k.title: K

noise.description: overlap@k of the base's two lists: the tool's own noise.
noise.title: Noise

overlap.description: overlap@k of the base's first list and the variant's.
overlap.title: Overlap

status.description: `no_dry_run` for a tool that writes state and has no dry run: it is never called. `tool_error` when a call failed, `infrastructure_error` when the runner could not run the case.
status.title: Status

CounterfactualCase.title: CounterfactualCase

CounterfactualEngaged.description:
An item the person engaged with in the recorded turn, by its 1-based position in each live list;
absent where the list does not hold it.
CounterfactualEngaged.title: CounterfactualEngaged

CounterfactualEngagement.description: Where the items the person engaged with went without the element, over the completed cases.

gained.description: Within the variant's first `k` and not the base's.
gained.title: Gained

kept.description: Within the first `k` of both lists.
kept.title: Kept

lost.description: Within the base's first `k` and not the variant's.
lost.title: Lost

mean_shift.description: The variant's position minus the base's, averaged over the items both lists hold; positive when they fell.
mean_shift.title: Mean Shift

shown.description: Within the first `k` of the base's list.
shown.title: Shown

CounterfactualEngagement.title: CounterfactualEngagement

CounterfactualRun.description:
Whether the element changes what the tool returns, beyond the tool's own noise. It never says whether
the result got better, nor how the model reacts: `limits` says so, and what else holds the answer
back.

below_noise.description: Completed cases whose overlap is below their own noise.
below_noise.title: Below Noise

effect.description: `noise_floor - overlap`: how much of the first positions the element moves beyond noise.
effect.title: Effect

noise_floor.description: Mean overlap@k of the base with itself.
noise_floor.title: Noise Floor

overlap.description: Mean overlap@k of the base and the variant.
overlap.title: Overlap

p_value.description: The two-sided sign test of `below_noise` against `above_noise`: how likely a split this uneven is when the element changes nothing.
p_value.title: P Value

CounterfactualRun.title: CounterfactualRun

CounterfactualRunCreate.description:
What a runner measured in the company's CI for one tool and one element (the tool counterfactual
spec).

k.description: The positions compared when a recorded list has no `visible_k`.
k.title: K

label.description: A name for the run, such as the commit or the build it ran on.
label.title: Label

CounterfactualRunCreate.title: CounterfactualRunCreate

DataIssue.description:
A problem in the company's data, returned to its owner with no personal data: one open issue per
class, type, field and source, counted each time it is found again.

acknowledged_at.description: Once acknowledged, the next occurrence opens a new issue.
acknowledged_at.title: Acknowledged At

kind.description: `null_field`, `out_of_vocabulary`, `stale_source`, `invalid_value`: a value an agent's tool showed; `coverage_drop`: a field filled less often than before; `divergence`: two sources of one value disagree; `drift`: the schema a type mirrors changed, and a new field is already served to agents as it came (a note, nothing to fix); `field_held`: a new field that may be personal data or free text, held from agents until the type declares it; `rule_conflict`: two rules decide one thing differently; `type_undeclared`: tools showed objects of a type the space never declared.
kind.title: Kind

refs.description: The first objects it was seen on, up to 50.
refs.title: Refs

source.description: Where the data came from: a tool or a system of record.
source.title: Source

DataIssue.title: DataIssue

DeclareRequest.description:
What happened, after the fact: one kind of declaration, with the fields of its kind in `detail` (the
coordination spec, 5).
DeclareRequest.title: DeclareRequest

DerivedState.description:
A field the type derives from the related objects of one relation (a look's pieces), computed at this
read and never stored. A related object whose data is not known leaves it `unobserved`, unless the answer
is already decided.

over.description: The related objects it was computed over.
over.title: Over

pieces_out.description: When it is not `yes`, the related objects, as `type:namespace:id`, that kept it from `yes`: for `all` and `any` the ones the condition does not hold for or that are not known, for `count`, `min` and `max` the ones not known. In the relation's order, the first 10.
pieces_out.title: Pieces Out

unknown.description: How many of them were not known: out of the working set, not an exact match (`status_field`), or with the data the condition reads not observed.
unknown.title: Unknown

DerivedState.title: DerivedState

Detect.description:
How a category finds its claims in the text, without a model: numbers of these classes, the words
around them that give their role, terms of the trade, named patterns, or sections of a document.

roles.description: The words that give a number its role, synonyms and every language in one list.
roles.title: Roles

terms.description: With `classes`, a number counts only in a sentence that holds one of them; alone, the term is the claim.
terms.title: Terms

Detect.title: Detect

DriftChanges.description:
What changed between the declaration and the type the schema proposes now, as counts: never a new name,
a value or a definition (object-type spec, 8.8.2).

fields.description: The declaration's fields removed or retyped, and its state field when the states differ.
fields.title: Fields

DriftChanges.title: DriftChanges

Effect.description:
`effect_id` is the key's keyed hash: it names the effect in paths, where the key itself, which may
carry a conversation id, never goes.
Effect.title: Effect

EffectDetail.description: How the attempt the caller holds ended.
EffectDetail.title: EffectDetail

EffectStatus.description: `none` means nothing held the key and this check reserved it: the caller acts and then declares.
EffectStatus.title: EffectStatus

exposure_id.description: Absent for an item of no list.
exposure_id.title: Exposure Id

ExperimentReport.description:
Every experiment on an element or an agent, arm by arm, from what people did after they were assigned:
incremental, as only a holdout says.
ExperimentReport.title: ExperimentReport

comparisons.description: Empty until each arm holds enough people for the normal approximation.
comparisons.title: Comparisons

cuped_days.description: The days before each person's assignment taken as the covariate.
cuped_days.title: Cuped Days

Feature.description:
The agent features a space turns on: everything is off until the space's `features`
document lists it, and `GET /v1/sdk/profile` announces what is on.
Feature.title: Feature

age_p50_s.description: The median age, in seconds, of the field's newest observation.
age_p50_s.title: Age P50 S

coverage.description: The share of the type's objects some source observed the field of.
coverage.title: Coverage

FieldState.description:
One field as a read serves it: the value with its logical value, stamps, source and observer, and the
freshness computed now against the type's current rule.

known_at.description: When Niadra first knew it; never moves.
known_at.title: Known At

masked.description: The reader's access masks the value: `v` is absent.
masked.title: Masked

observed_at.description: When the source observed the value.
observed_at.title: Observed At

FieldState.title: FieldState

Handle.description: An identifier of a subject in some channel or system: a phone, an e-mail, a CRM id.

scope.description: Namespace for scoped identifiers: the WhatsApp Business account for `wa_bsuid`, the system for `system_id`, the country for `gov_id_hmac`.
scope.title: Scope

subject_kind.description: Defaults to `person`, except for organization-only handle types.

Handle.title: Handle

HandoffContext.description:
The compiled `handoff` view, at the receiving side's policy and verification level. `etag` is the
pack's it was compiled from, absent for a subject the memory knows nothing of yet.
HandoffContext.title: HandoffContext

HandoffCreate.description:
Hands the subject to `target`. The package is compiled at `level`, the verification the receiving
side has of the subject, so it never carries what that side could not read.

agent.description: The agent handing off; the calling key's name when absent.
agent.title: Agent

expected_by.description: When the outcome is due; the space's default wait when absent.
expected_by.title: Expected By

HandoffCreate.title: HandoffCreate

HandoffPackage.description: What a handoff carries to whoever receives it (the coordination spec, 7).
HandoffPackage.title: HandoffPackage

HardConstraint.description: Only what the person said: an inference is never hard.

object.description: With `scope: object`, the object the instruction is about.
object.title: Object

HardConstraint.title: HardConstraint

IdentityCalibration.description:
How often the identity method names the exposure the line's own token names, on the lines where both
exist: the confidence of that method in this space.
IdentityCalibration.title: IdentityCalibration

Inference.description:
One thing the signals infer about the subject, with what it rests on: the subject can see it, correct
it and delete it. What the subject said is not an inference, and is not listed.

attr.description: The field whose value is inferred.
attr.title: Attr

evidence.description: What it rests on, as counts: effective exposure, weighted signal, events, sessions and lift for a value; times for an interest.
evidence.title: Evidence

key.description: A keyed hash that names the inference; it never carries its value.
key.title: Key

kind.description: `soft_constraint` when the constraints block carries it as a soft entry, `attribute` for the inferred size, `affinity` for a value with evidence and no entry yet, `interest` for an object, `instruction` for what the subject said must or must not be done about an object (`ref`, the words in `value`): said, not inferred, and listed so a correction can withdraw it.
kind.title: Kind

origin.description: `interactions`, `implicit_negative` (shown often and never engaged with), or why an interest was kept: `engaged`, `feedback`, `watch`.
origin.title: Origin

used_for.description: The purposes it is used for.
used_for.title: Used For

Inference.title: Inference

InferenceCorrection.description:
The value the subject says instead: a stated preference, or a stated attribute for an inferred size
(`source: correction`). The inference it corrects is deleted. An interest is deleted, not corrected.
InferenceCorrection.title: InferenceCorrection

InterestState.description: A shared object the subject showed interest in, as it stands now.

object.description: The object as a `display` read serves it; absent once it left the working set.

InterestState.title: InterestState

InterleavingReport.description:
Interleaved lists of a tool's two rankings (team draft, seeded by the turn): which ranking the
person's engagement credited, impression by impression, by day and over the period.
InterleavingReport.title: InterleavingReport

ties.description: Impressions engaged with equally, or not at all.
ties.title: Ties

wins_a.description: Impressions whose engagement went to the items ranking `a` contributed.
wins_a.title: Wins A

p_value.description: The two-sided sign test on the decided impressions; absent before any was decided.
p_value.title: P Value

InternalText.description:
Fingerprints of the company's own prompt: hashes of every `n` words, computed by the SDK, never the
prompt itself. An output that repeats one gives way to `redact`, recorded as a claim of the category
`internal_text` with the verdict `internal_text_found`, the action taken and, as evidence, the
`shingle_hashes_ref` in `document`.

shingle_hashes_ref.description: The prompt version the hashes were computed from.
shingle_hashes_ref.title: Shingle Hashes Ref

InternalText.title: InternalText

LeaseDetail.description:
An owner lease or a case, held by the declaring agent. `level` defaults to the space's least
restrictive level.
LeaseDetail.title: LeaseDetail

LegalHoldCreate.description:
Exactly one of `handle`, `object` or `conversation_id`: what is kept from purging while the hold is
active.
LegalHoldCreate.title: LegalHoldCreate

Natures.description:
How a number is handled by where it came from: computed (a value with provenance in the turn, by rule
or observed) is checked against it; quoted (inside quotation marks) is checked only for being in a source,
as written, even when it is false; said by the model (no origin) takes this action, or the category's.
Natures.title: Natures

param.description: The argument that takes the values the field must not have.
param.title: Param

Notification.description:
A webhook's body, for the company that pulls instead of receiving it: the same fields, ids and
pointers only. An event aimed at one endpoint, or about a memory item only some sources may read,
reaches its webhooks only.

id.description: The event's id; a webhook delivery of the same event has its own.
id.title: Id

Notification.title: Notification

NotificationPage.description: Oldest first. `next_cursor` is where the next poll starts: the same cursor when nothing is new.
NotificationPage.title: NotificationPage

ObjectCoverage.description:
How much of each declared field the objects of each type carry, and how old it is, from the stamps
alone: never a value.
ObjectCoverage.title: ObjectCoverage

ObjectInstruction.description:
What someone said must or must not be done about an object the read is about: a task on the object,
a read by the object, or a task view of its type. Hard, never relaxed, never inferred; one about a field
of the object's type is also in `hard`, where a tool binding applies it.

about.description: Naming no object: the organization (its profile) it is about, a client the read is about, its own reads or a contact's read with `about`.
about.title: About

attr.description: The field of the object's type it is about.
attr.title: Attr

contact.description: A contact preference (a channel, hours): how the company reaches `only_with`, never a limit on what may be said to them.
contact.title: Contact

hard.description: The entry of `hard` that carries it for a tool, when `attr` is set.
hard.title: Hard

only_with.description: The one person it holds with, as the conversation named them: it binds the readers dealing with that person, not whoever is speaking. With `contact`, the person it is the preference of.
only_with.title: Only With

role.description: The role on the object of who said it (`owner`, `participant`, `lawyer`).
role.title: Role

text.description: As it was said, short: what a reader honors without a tool binding.
text.title: Text

ObjectInstruction.title: ObjectInstruction

ObjectMemoryOut.description:
What the owner and participants of an object said about it (memory bound to the object), newest
first, at most 20 of each kind, as this reader may read it.

instructions.description: What must or must not be done about the object.
instructions.title: Instructions

items.description: Promises, disputes and requests about the object still open.
items.title: Items

ObjectMemoryOut.title: ObjectMemoryOut

inputs.description: For a derived object (a customer's quote, a shared best offer): the objects its inputs are fields of, by the name its type gives them, as `type:namespace:id` (`{"lead": "lead:crm:L-9"}`). When a field of one of them changes, the object expires, naming the input. A shared object's inputs are shared objects: a customer's object is never one.
inputs.title: Inputs

request_id.description: The refresh request this item answers, from the resolver worker's lease: the request is settled, and a `watch_revalidation` is decided on these values even when they are not newer than the ones held.
request_id.title: Request Id

version.description: The source's version of the object. A field moves only when this is greater than the version that last wrote it; a source never reuses a version for other content.
version.title: Version

ObjectPushResponse.description:
How many items of the request each decision took, against the hot layer, with no database statement.

A shared object's item is `applied` when at least one of its fields moved forward: reads serve it at once,
and the consolidator writes it within a second with the same per-field rule, so the stored object never
disagrees with the answer. `stale_version`: every field was already written by this version or a greater
one, as a retried request finds. `out_of_set`: the object is not in the working set, and nothing is kept.
A subject's object is `recorded`: accepted as a system event about it, in the request's one statement,
and its fields move by the same rule when the event is applied.
ObjectPushResponse.title: ObjectPushResponse

ObjectRead.description:
One object as a state read serves it: fields with four logical values and their stamps, computed
values, lifecycle, timers and readings, and what may not be claimed with data this old. A read never
refuses; a `decide` read of a type that asks for it carries `refusal` beside the values, for the company's
tool.

axes.description: Each time axis of the type whose value is known: a date as `YYYY-MM-DD`, an instant in UTC. The platform keeps `known_at` (when the producer first knew of the object) and the time its content last changed.
axes.title: Axes

blocked.description: What the fields whose value is not known block, as the type declares it (`unobserved_blocks`): each activity (`model_read`, `derive`, `claim`, or a task of the company such as `decide:close`) with the fields that block it. Nothing else is blocked.
blocked.title: Blocked

derived.description: The type's derived fields, from the related objects.
derived.title: Derived

expired_by.description: The inputs whose change expired it.
expired_by.title: Expired By

memory.description: What its owner and participants said about it, in a context read that serves a pack.

withheld.description: Fields left out for this reader, and why.
withheld.title: Withheld

ObjectRead.title: ObjectRead

ObjectRef.description: A business object in a system of record, e.g. `invoice` / `erp` / `0823`.
ObjectRef.title: ObjectRef

ObjectSnapshotResponse.description:
A snapshot taken in: its lines are applied as pushes of provenance `snapshot`, which never sustain a
claim, by the same version rule.
ObjectSnapshotResponse.title: ObjectSnapshotResponse

OutcomeLink.description:
One outcome attributed to what an agent did, by one method. `line` and `order` are deterministic: the
exposure token the order line or the order carried, or the agent's own action on the object.
`identity` and `assisted_handoff` are probable: the same item engaged with or shown within a window, or a
handoff that assisted the sale. A link carries its line's value whole or none at all: a value is never
weighted.

confidence.description: Of an `identity` link: how often that method names the exposure a line's own token names in this space, where both exist. Beside the value, never multiplied by it.
confidence.title: Confidence

final_at.description: When a provisional link becomes final.
final_at.title: Final At

finality.description: `provisional` until the exchange window ends or the object reaches a final state; `expired_without_outcome` when its deadline passed first.
finality.title: Finality

outcome.description: The outcome definition of the `measurement` document.
outcome.title: Outcome

purchase.description: The purchase it counts in, when the revenue definition counts a split purchase's parts as one order.
purchase.title: Purchase

state.description: The state the object or its line is in.
state.title: State

value_minor.description: In the currency's minor units, as the signed revenue definition counts it; absent: none.
value_minor.title: Value Minor

OutcomeLink.title: OutcomeLink

OutcomeRequest.description: How the receiving side reports back: one of `vocabulary`, by `expected_by`.
OutcomeRequest.title: OutcomeRequest

state.description: A canonical state of the type, or `expired_without_outcome`.
state.title: State

Owner.description:
Who holds the subject or the object now: the most restrictive valid claim, where it came from and
until when. `epoch` fences a release.
Owner.title: Owner

PowerRequest.description:
How long the space's traffic takes to detect a difference of `effect` (relative: 0.1 is 10%) on
`metric`. The traffic and the baseline come from the space's history, the named experiment's or the
busiest one's of the last 28 days, unless given.

baseline_mean.description: Per person: a rate for `conversion`, minor units for `value`.
baseline_mean.title: Baseline Mean

baseline_sd.description: Per person, for `value`; a rate's follows from its mean.
baseline_sd.title: Baseline Sd

daily_people.description: New people a day entering the test.
daily_people.title: Daily People

effect.description: The relative difference to detect: 0.1 is 10%.
effect.title: Effect

experiment.description: The experiment whose history to use.
experiment.title: Experiment

PowerRequest.title: PowerRequest

days.description: At a fixed horizon, looked at once, at the end.
days.title: Days

experiment.description: The experiment whose history was used.
experiment.title: Experiment

people.description: Both arms together, at a fixed horizon.
people.title: People

people_sequential.description: Both arms together, for the daily-looked sequential test to have decided with `power`.
people_sequential.title: People Sequential

Preference.description: What the person wants or refuses, said or captured from a tool's arguments; only these become hard.

category.description: Holds only in this category of the type.
category.title: Category

Preference.title: Preference

Presented.description:
A list delivered to the person: the exposure. Its canonical moment is `delivered_at`, when the
interface bridge handed the list to the client, never when a tool returned it or the model named it.

method.description: `bridge` from the interface bridge, `otel` from a `niadra.exposure` span, `tool_result` inferred from what a tool returned: labeled, because it counts more than was shown.
method.title: Method

page.description: "See more" is the same list with `page + 1`.
page.title: Page

visible_k.description: How many of the first items were visible on delivery.
visible_k.title: Visible K

Presented.title: Presented

pos.description: 1-based position in the whole list, across pages.
pos.title: Pos

shown.description: The values the item showed, for the fields its type tracks or lets be claimed; what `changes_since_seen` later compares against.
shown.title: Shown

team.description: Which of two interleaved lists contributed the item.
team.title: Team

PreviousValue.description: A field's value before its latest change, kept for the fields that declare `track_changes`.
PreviousValue.title: PreviousValue

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details; `code` comes from the versioned error catalog.
Problem.title: Problem

PromoteRequest.description:
Moves turns from the short tier (every turn, 7 days) to the kept one, by conversation or by id, with
the reason: the complaint arrives days after the turn.
PromoteRequest.title: PromoteRequest

not_found.description: Turns no longer in the short tier, or never recorded.
not_found.title: Not Found

Provenance.description:
Where pushed values come from: only a `live` source sustains a claim, and the age of every value counts
from `source_observed_at`.
Provenance.title: Provenance

ReadingResult.description:
A named reading's value, as niadra-expr computes it: the logical value, and the kind and value when
known (dates as `YYYY-MM-DD`, times in UTC, durations in milliseconds).

inputs.description: For a reading that includes its inputs: the derived object's inputs, by the name its type gives them, as `type:namespace:id`.
inputs.title: Inputs

ReadingResult.title: ReadingResult

ReconcileResult.description:
Our value of each line against the BI's, on the lines both know; lines only one side knows are
counted apart and never enter the deviation.

deviation.description: |ours - BI| / BI on the lines both know.
deviation.title: Deviation

ReconcileResult.title: ReconcileResult

RefreshRelease.description:
A leased request the resolver worker cannot answer: the object is not at the source, or fetching it
failed. The request leaves at once and its paid call counts; a `watch_revalidation` falls back to the
type's `unconfirmed_watch`.
RefreshRelease.title: RefreshRelease

ReleaseDetail.description: The claim a case closes, with the epoch it got when it was accepted.
ReleaseDetail.title: ReleaseDetail

Rendered.description: The block for one tool, through its bindings (`constraints.v0`, rendering).

args.description: Argument values that carry hard constraints and attributes.
args.title: Args

post_filter.description: Residual ids the SDK filters from the results of an overfetch.
post_filter.title: Post Filter

residual.description: Ids no argument of the tool can express.
residual.title: Residual

Rendered.title: Rendered

ReplayAssertion.description:
A structural check on the replayed turn's record, evaluated by the runner. The replay spec fixes each
kind's `args` and how it is evaluated; a kind the runner cannot evaluate yields `not_checked`.

suggested.description: Suggested by rule from the recorded turn.
suggested.title: Suggested

turn_id.description: The one turn of the scenario it applies to; every turn when absent.
turn_id.title: Turn Id

ReplayAssertion.title: ReplayAssertion

ReplayBlocker.description:
Why a turn cannot be run again: `content_mode` (`hash_only` keeps no value), `fidelity` (only a gold
record can be replayed), `completeness` (only a complete one) or `missing_pin` (the pin the recording
requires and the record lacks).
ReplayBlocker.title: ReplayBlocker

ReplayCase.description:
What the replay runner needs to run a turn again inside the company's boundary: the record, with the
kept values in `stored` mode and the pointers and digests otherwise; the pins; the conversation's masked
history up to the turn, ending with the turn's own input; and the assertions. The pack of the time is
the blob of the record's `pack` read.

expires_at.description: When the turn leaves storage; after it, `replay_expired`.
expires_at.title: Expires At

ReplayCase.title: ReplayCase

ReplayCaseRequest.description:
A case for one turn, alone or as part of a scenario. `build` is the build the runner will run; every
pin the recording requires must match the recorded one, except the pins in `vary`, which the run changes
on purpose.
ReplayCaseRequest.title: ReplayCaseRequest

text.description: The customer's message that opened the turn, masked.
text.title: Text

ReplayResult.description:
One execution of one case. `infrastructure_error` (the agent raised, a blob could not be fetched or
did not match its digest, a timeout) is counted apart and never fails an assertion; `pin_mismatch` is a
case the runner stopped at its pin check.

paraphrase.description: The run's input was a paraphrase of the recorded one.
paraphrase.title: Paraphrase

ReplayResult.title: ReplayResult

ResultObjects.description: Where a result carries objects of a type, and which key of each item holds which field.

id.description: The key of the item that holds the object's id.
id.title: Id

ResultObjects.title: ResultObjects

explanation.description: Built from receipts: their ids, kinds, surfaces, rules, versions and inputs by reference, never personal content.
explanation.title: Explanation

ReviewRequestCreate.description: A request to review an automated decision, sent to the controller's data protection officer.

decision_receipt_id.description: The receipt of the decision; absent, the subject's recent decisions.
decision_receipt_id.title: Decision Receipt Id

ReviewRequestCreate.title: ReviewRequestCreate

SaidAbout.description: One row of what people and agents said about an object, kept under the person who said it.

audience.description: `shared` reaches every participant of the object, a customer-facing agent included; `internal`, the internal readers only.
audience.title: Audience

by.description: The handle of who said it; only in the Console.
by.title: By

claim_safe.description: Always false: what was said may be reported as said, never stated as the record.
claim_safe.title: Claim Safe

diverges.description: The value said differs from the one recorded: a data issue was opened.
diverges.title: Diverges

id.description: The fact, open item or instruction it is.
id.title: Id

observes.description: The field of the object's type an observation is about: shown beside the value the system of record holds, never in its place.
observes.title: Observes

recorded.description: The value the system of record holds for `observes`.
recorded.title: Recorded

role.description: The role of who said it on the object (`owner`, `participant`, `lawyer`).
role.title: Role

SaidAbout.title: SaidAbout

version.description: Grows with every change of the name, the assertions or the status.
version.title: Version

ScenarioCreate.description:
Turns kept as a scenario, with the assertions they must keep passing; without assertions, the ones
suggested by rule from the turns.
ScenarioCreate.title: ScenarioCreate

ScenarioFromReport.description:
A bug report becomes a scenario: its turns are kept and assertions suggested by rule, from the turns
and from words of the description. The description is read, never stored.
ScenarioFromReport.title: ScenarioFromReport

verdict.description: The worst of the scenarios' verdicts.
verdict.title: Verdict

ScenarioRunCreate.description:
What the company's CI reports after running the scenarios N times: the statistics stay with Niadra.
Every pin the recording requires must match each scenario's recorded build, except those in `vary`.
ScenarioRunCreate.title: ScenarioRunCreate

baseline_run_id.description: The earlier run compared against; none when it was the recording.
baseline_run_id.title: Baseline Run Id

needs_paraphrase.description: An assertion passed and failed across the runs: its next run must include paraphrases.
needs_paraphrase.title: Needs Paraphrase

SdkProfile.description:
What the SDK keeps in its local cache: the features on, the source's tool bindings, the summarized
type registry, the claim contract and turn recording.

recording.description: How this source records turns, once the space records them.

tool_bindings.description: The bindings of the tools this source's agents call.
tool_bindings.title: Tool Bindings

SdkProfile.title: SdkProfile

Seen.description: A ping of the list component: how far the person saw.
Seen.title: Seen

values.description: The numbers the object was last shown with (a price, a total, a discount, an installment), by field: each field its type declares as `money`, `percent` or `number`. A claim check takes them as evidence for the offer an agent quotes back.
values.title: Values

ShownValue.description: A number an object showed the subject, as they were shown it.

claim_safe.description: Whether it may be claimed now: its type allows claims of the field, and no more than the field's age for claims has passed since it was shown.
claim_safe.title: Claim Safe

ShownValue.title: ShownValue

StateRef.description: An object of the type registry: a subject's or a shared one, whose key may name a variant.
StateRef.title: StateRef

StateView.description:
The state of one subject (the `now` view): their objects of the declared types, each as a `display`
read serves it; the shared objects they showed interest in, and what changed since they saw them; and
the same as short lines for the turn block.

text.description: The view as lines for the turn block, after `slots`: never part of the pack's `text`, so the cached prefix keeps its bytes. Absent when there is nothing to say.
text.title: Text

StateView.title: StateView

Suppression.description:
One entry of the suppression list: `key` is the subject's handle keyed with the reading source's salt
(the suppression-list spec); `removed` takes the entry `id` out of the reader's copy. The reason stays
with the producer: a vendor learns that it may not contact, never why.
Suppression.title: Suppression

SuppressionAddedDetail.description:
The subject may not be contacted for `purpose`, on `channel` or on every channel. `until` defaults to
the reason's own interval, or to no end.
SuppressionAddedDetail.title: SuppressionAddedDetail

SuppressionLiftedDetail.description: Lifts what the same source suppressed for `purpose` and `channel`.
SuppressionLiftedDetail.title: SuppressionLiftedDetail

SuppressionPage.description:
A page of changes, oldest first. With `reset`, the reader drops its copy before applying `items`:
the salt changed, or the cursor is older than what the list keeps.
SuppressionPage.title: SuppressionPage

due_at.description: Computed now from the rule and the values.
due_at.title: Due At

supersedes_firing_id.description: The firing this one replaces: a timer that already fired fires again once the value that armed it is revised.
supersedes_firing_id.title: Supersedes Firing Id

dry_run_param.description: The argument that makes a call change nothing, for a counterfactual.
dry_run_param.title: Dry Run Param

mask_output.description: The SDK masks the fields the key may not read in the tool's output.
mask_output.title: Mask Output

overfetch.description: The tool returns more than asked: the SDK filters the residual from it.
overfetch.title: Overfetch

relax_flag.description: Where the result says the tool relaxed what it was asked.
relax_flag.title: Relax Flag

name.description: The agent's name inside the source, e.g. `closing`.

parent_turn_id.description: The turn that opened this one as a sub-turn (a sub-agent, an agent as tool).

always has the same hash.

pointer.description: Where the customer keeps it, in `pointer` mode.
pointer.title: Pointer

TurnBlob.title: TurnBlob

adapter.description: The framework adapter and its version, if any.
adapter.title: Adapter

name.title: Name

corpus_digest.description: Digest of the files the agent consults, computed in the SDK; never the files.
